description: This file contains an implementation of top-down splay trees with size maintenance, including functions for splaying, inserting, and deleting nodes within a splay tree data structure. It also includes detailed comments and references about the algorithm and its origins.

methods.name: splaytree_splay_nonnull
methods.description: Performs splay operation on the tree for a given key, bringing the node with the key or the closest node to the root.

methods.name: splay_tree * splaytree_insert_splayed(splay_tree * t,int i,void * data)
methods.description: Inserts a new node with a specified key into an already splayed tree, returning the new tree root.

methods.name: splay_tree * splaytree_insert(splay_tree * t,int i,void * data)
methods.description: Inserts a key into the tree if not already present, splaying the tree beforehand if necessary.

methods.name: splaytree_delete_splayed_node
methods.description: Deletes a node from the tree that has already been splayed to the root.

methods.name: splay_tree * splaytree_delete(splay_tree * t,int i)
methods.description: Deletes a specified key from the tree if present, restructuring the tree accordingly.
